info.title: GP247 REST API v2
info.description: REST API v2 of gp247/core, gp247/front and gp247/shop. Every error body is {"error":1,"msg":"…","code":"…"}. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header (since 3.4.0; a valid id sent by the client is reused). A group turned off on the API management screen answers 404 with code api_disabled (since 3.3.1). See api-introduction.md. API v1 (frozen) is described separately in openapi-v1.json and api-v1.md. API v2 sessions (since core 3.6.0 / shop 3.4.0): with_refresh on login returns a rotating refresh token; a sign-in challenge registered by a plugin answers 401 challenge_required. Admin lists of api/v2/core (since core 3.7.0 / shop 3.6.0 / front 3.4.0) have a change-sync mode: updated_since + page[after]. Event log for ERP / sync tools (since core 3.7.0, off by default): GET api/v2/core/events, read by the after cursor.

parameters.description: Optional; 8-255 printable characters (e.g. a UUID). A retry with the same key and body answers the first result

get.description: Returns change events (orders, stock, products, customers) oldest first, for ERP and sync tools. Send ?after=<last id handled> to continue; page[size] default 100, max 500; filter[type]=a,b narrows the types. Only types of screens the admin may open and the admin's store are returned; events younger than a few seconds are held back. 409 when the event log is off, 410 when the cursor points to cleaned events.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: id of the last event the reader handled; returns the events after it. Omitted = from the oldest event still kept

parameters.name: filter[type]
parameters.description: Comma-separated event types (<resource>.<action>); only narrows the types the admin may read. gp247/shop 3.6.0 types: order.created, order.status_changed, order.payment_status_changed, stock.changed, product.updated, product.deleted, customer.created, customer.updated

403.description: The admin may not open the admin screen of any event type

409.description: code event_log_disabled: the event log is turned off on the API management screen

410.description: code cursor_expired: events after this cursor were cleaned; resync with updated_since and read events again without after

422.description: after is not an event id, or filter[type] is not a comma-separated list

get.x-gp247-permission: Read access to the admin screen of each event type returned: Orders for order.*, Products for product.* and stock.*, Customers for customer.*.

get.description: Returns the profile and role slugs of the admin who owns the token. Any active admin token may call it; no screen permission is needed.

post.description: Signs an active admin in with username and password and returns a bearer token. With with_refresh=true the answer adds a refresh token and the access token lives a short time. When a plugin requires a second step (MFA), the answer is 401 challenge_required with a ticket to finish on login/challenge. Failed attempts are limited per account and IP.
Signs the current session out: its access token stops working and its refresh token can no longer be used. Any active admin token may call it.

post.description: Receives or issues goods with delta (positive or negative), or overwrites the stock after a count with set (administrators only). Stock never goes below zero and the sold counter is untouched; build products are refused. An Idempotency-Key header is required so a retry never moves stock twice.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required; 8-255 printable characters (e.g. a UUID). A retry with the same key and body moves the stock once and answers the first result (header Idempotent-Replayed: true)
